business_problem: STADLER needed to reduce the time employees spent summarizing, translating, drafting, and turning raw knowledge into usable output while scaling modern knowledge work across a 650-person industrial business.
solution_summary: STADLER rolled out ChatGPT as a company-wide productivity layer so employees could turn drafting, translation, summarization, and knowledge-reuse work into a faster, repeatable operating model. After evaluating alternatives, the company chose ChatGPT for output quality, speed, and immediate usability, then combined top-down direction with bottom-up experimentation so every employee working on a computer would use AI in daily work. Teams created more than 125 custom GPTs for recurring tasks and used them to standardize how knowledge becomes proposals, social content, and other first drafts. Rather than treat the model as a standalone writing tool, STADLER used it as a structured thought partner embedded into everyday workflows, allowing teams to compress half-day drafting cycles into minutes while preserving human review and decision-making.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT
solution_components.role: Provides the shared conversational workspace where employees summarize, translate, draft, and structure knowledge work.

solution_components.name: Custom GPTs
solution_components.role: Package repeatable prompts and workflow logic for department-specific tasks across the company.

data_flow: Employees bring raw notes, documents, and source material into ChatGPT, where custom GPTs turn them into structured drafts, summaries, translations, and reusable outputs. Those outputs flow back into marketing, internal communication, and other team workflows for human review and final publication.
business_outcome: STADLER created 125+ custom GPTs, achieved 30-40% time savings on common knowledge tasks, improved first-draft speed by 2.5x on average, and reached daily usage above 85% across its AI-enabled workforce.
